move: words rush in skewed, six lagging ghost copies smear a motion trail
how: A dark stage with a drifting grid and three words, each built from a lead span plus six ghost spans that carry a directional feGaussianBlur (22 1) and decreasing opacity. Every move is applied to the lead and then to each ghost 0.035s later, which draws the smear. KINETIC rushes from xPercent -170 to 0 (expo.out, 0.75s, at 1%) with skewX -28 easing to 0; at 29% it shoots up yPercent -320 (expo.in) and TYPE drops in from yPercent 320 with a scaleY 1.25 settle; at 56% TYPE exits left and TRAIL enters from the right with skewX 26; at 85% TRAIL leaves to the right with skewX 18. The grid translates -80px on both axes over the clip, matching its 80px period, so the loop is seamless.
adapt: Change the three words and their colours, GHOSTS count and lag, blur strength in the filter; keep the 0.035s ghost lag, the expo.out in / expo.in out pairing and the skew as velocity.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the layer spans per word and the SVG filter def; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with moves at 0.01D, 0.29D, 0.56D, 0.85D. The fromTo tweens need immediateRender:false plus the gsap.set start positions in mount; scope selectors to el.
caveats: fromTo tweens rely on immediateRender:false and initial gsap.set positions
